text:
Taylor: Quick late-afternoon thing tomorrow? 5:45pm kettlebell circuit in the office gym (30m) then an easy 5k pub run (cooldown pace) ending at The Anchor for a post-run pint. Low-key, all levels welcome. :kettlebell: :running_shirt_with_sash: :beer:

Rox: Love the pub run idea. I'll do kettlebells + run. Can someone bring an extra light for the route back?

Gabe: In for kettlebells only (got a late meeting after). Can bring a 12kg and 16kg bell.

Marta: Pub run for me  will meet at the gym at 5:40 for short warmup then tag along on the run. Also happy to collect tabs for the Anchor if folks want to pre-order snacks.

Taylor: React with :kettlebell: if you're joining the circuit, :runner: for the pub run, :beer: if you'll stay for a pint. I'll post a simple circuit (AMRAP-ish) if we have 4+ people.

Rox: :kettlebell: :runner: :beer:

Gabe: :kettlebell:

Marta: :runner: :beer:

wellness-bot: Note: Gym capacity 8. Please wipe equipment after use. Automated reminder: bring a towel.

Taylor: Plan: 5:45 kettlebell circuit (20-25m), quick stretch, depart ~6:15 for a flat 5k loop to The Anchor. Route is lit but bring lights if you have them. No one left behind pace  walk intervals ok.

Rox: I'll bring a small headlamp and a spare buffer gel. Also: who wants me to queue a non-cheesy playlist? :musical_note:

Gabe: I can borrow a second light if needed. Shoe sizes for spare socks? (kidding). See you at 5:40.

Marta: Anchor tab sounds great. I'll DM Taylor the snack order. See y'all! :sparkles:
